svg.text: Base layer — Canary (matrix) on U.S. QWERTY via Karabiner
arrows I J K L (modifiers pass through)
Extend + ⌘ → shortcuts at physical QWERTY positions (rescue bindings: Z X C V F S N Q T)
Shift passes through everywhere: ⇧G = +, ⇧M = >, ⇧ + arrows = select. Tap Caps alone = Caps Lock.
Small gray corner labels = physical QWERTY key. Faint keys fall through to the Canary base layer.
